graph.summary: Insulin lispro → Insulin receptor → glucose import → Hyperglycemia → Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus

evidence.snippet: The affinity in vitro was identical to that of insulin for its receptor.
evidence.explanation: Insulin lispro (created by inverting lysine and proline at B28/B29) binds the insulin receptor with affinity identical to native insulin, acting as a full receptor agonist.

paper.title: [From the concept of fast acting analogs to the properties of the insulin Lispro].

evidence.snippet: the binding causes conformational changes in the receptor molecule
evidence.explanation: Ligand binding to the insulin receptor alpha subunits triggers conformational changes that stimulate autophosphorylation and promote the receptor's kinase activity.

paper.title: [Chemical structure, active sites and receptor binding of insulin molecule and its signal transduction].
paper.journal: Nihon rinsho. Japanese journal of clinical medicine

evidence.snippet: insulin promotes membrane trafficking of the glucose transporter GLUT4 from GLUT4 storage vesicles to the plasma membrane, thereby facilitating the uptake of glucose from the circulation
evidence.explanation: Activation of the insulin receptor by insulin drives GLUT4 translocation to the plasma membrane, promoting glucose import into muscle and adipose tissue.

paper.title: Molecular mechanisms for the regulation of insulin-stimulated glucose uptake by small guanosine triphosphatases in skeletal muscle and adipocytes.

evidence.snippet: insulin-induced GLUT4 translocation from intracellular compartments to the cell membrane, which increases the overall rate of glucose flux into a cell
evidence.explanation: Insulin receptor signaling increases glucose flux into cells via GLUT4 translocation.

paper.title: Current understanding of glucose transporter 4 expression and functional mechanisms.

evidence.snippet: glucose uptake into skeletal muscle and lower blood glucose levels
evidence.explanation: Increased glucose uptake into tissues lowers blood glucose levels, opposing hyperglycemia.

paper.title: 14-Deoxy-11,12-Didehydroandrographolide Ameliorates Glucose Intolerance Enhancing the LKB1/AMPK[Formula: see text]/TBC1D1/GLUT4 Signaling Pathway and Inducing GLUT4 Expression in Myotubes and Skeletal Muscle of Obese Mice.
paper.journal: The American journal of Chinese medicine

evidence.snippet: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is an organ-specific autoimmune disease characterized by the immune-mediated destruction of pancreatic β cells, leading to absolute insulin deficiency and chronic hyperglycemia.
evidence.explanation: Chronic hyperglycemia is a defining manifestation of Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus resulting from insulin deficiency; insulin lispro replaces the deficient insulin to correct it.

paper.title: Sensing danger in the islet: the roles of pattern recognition receptors in β cells and type 1 diabetes.
